title: 2026届高三英语听力仿真训练（03）｜健康运动
note: 原创仿真训练，按 2026 高考听力题型编写（第一节、第二节均播放两遍）。难度与风格参考：2026届皖南八校高三第一次联考（内容为原创，非真实试卷）。

sections.name: 第一节
sections.desc: 听下面5段对话。每段对话后有一个小题，从题中所给的A、B、C三个选项中选出最佳选项。听完每段对话后，你都有10秒钟的时间来回答有关小题和阅读下一小题。每段对话读两遍。

materials.label: 第1段材料
materials.transcript:
W: I'd like to join the gym. How much is it for students?
M: Thirty pounds a month, but students get twenty percent off.
W: So that's twenty-four pounds?
M: That's right. It also includes the pool. And the first week is free.

questions.text: How much will the woman pay each month?

materials.label: 第2段材料
materials.transcript:
M: I'm trying to cut down on soft drinks.
W: Good for you. I stopped drinking them last year.
M: Really? Was it hard?
W: The first week was, but now I don't miss them at all. Water is enough for me.

questions.text: How does the woman feel about giving up soft drinks?

options.A: She is glad she did it.

materials.label: 第3段材料
materials.transcript:
W: You look exhausted. Did you sleep badly?
M: I went to bed at half past twelve and got up at six.
W: That's only five and a half hours. You should try to be in bed by eleven.
M: I know, but I had a lot of homework.

questions.text: How long did the man sleep?

materials.label: 第4段材料
materials.transcript:
M: Are you coming swimming with us on Saturday?
W: I'd love to, but my shoulder still hurts from the tennis match.
M: Then maybe just come and watch. The pool has a café.
W: All right. I'll take some photos and cheer you on.

questions.text: What will the woman do on Saturday?

materials.label: 第5段材料
materials.transcript:
W: Doctor, I've had a stomach ache since yesterday.
M: What did you eat before it started?
W: I had a cheese sandwich and two cups of coffee.
M: Try plain food today and drink more water. Come back if it gets worse.

questions.text: What does the doctor advise the woman to do?

sections.name: 第二节
sections.desc: 听下面5段对话或独白。每段对话或独白后有几个小题，从题中所给的A、B、C三个选项中选出最佳选项。听每段对话或独白前，你将有时间阅读各个小题，每小题5秒钟；听完后，各小题将给出5秒钟的作答时间。每段对话或独白读两遍。

materials.label: 第6段材料
materials.transcript:
W: Hello, City Gym. How can I help?
M: I'd like to book a place in the evening yoga class.
W: The six o'clock class is full, but we have space at half past five.
M: How long does that class last?
W: It starts at half past five and ends at a quarter to seven. That's seventy-five minutes.
M: Good. I'll take it. Is the teacher the same?
W: Yes, Anna teaches both classes. We also have a Sunday class.
M: I finish work at five, so the time works well.
W: Please arrive ten minutes early. Do you have your own mat?
M: No. Can I rent one?
W: Yes, for one pound.
M: Great. My name is David Clark.
W: Thank you, David. See you tomorrow, David.

questions.text: When does the yoga class start?
How long is the class?

materials.label: 第7段材料
materials.transcript:
W: You've started cooking, haven't you? Your lunch looks different.
M: Yes. I used to buy sandwiches every day, but I was always hungry by three.
W: What do you make now?
M: Rice, vegetables and some chicken. I cook enough on Sunday for three days.
W: Doesn't it get boring?
M: A little, so I change the sauce. It's cheaper too. I save about twenty pounds a week.
W: Maybe I should try that. I spend too much on takeaway food.
M: Start with one meal. You don't have to cook every day.
W: Good idea. Could you send me the recipe you use?
M: Sure. It's simple: rice, carrots, peas and chicken. I also take fruit to school for a snack.
W: That sounds easy enough. I'll try it this weekend.

questions.text: What did the man usually eat for lunch before?
How does the man save money?
What does the man suggest the woman do first?

materials.label: 第8段材料
materials.transcript:
M: I've been feeling tired all week. I fall asleep in class.
W: Are you going to bed late?
M: Around one. My roommate watches videos with the sound on.
W: Have you asked him to use headphones?
M: I did, but he forgets. I don't want to argue with him. I tried earplugs last night, but they fell out.
W: You could talk to the dorm supervisor. Or ask to change rooms. A new room may really be the best answer.
M: I'd rather solve it myself. Maybe I'll try earplugs again.
W: That might help. But you also need a regular bedtime and less screen time.
M: True. I'll set an alarm for eleven every night and put my phone away.
W: Good. And no coffee after dinner, either.

questions.text: Why is the man so tired?
Why doesn't the man want to see the supervisor?

options.A: He prefers to solve it himself.
options.B: He is afraid of his roommate.

questions.text: What does the woman advise the man to avoid?

materials.label: 第9段材料
materials.transcript:
W: Coach, many people want to get fit but don't know where to start. What do you tell them?
M: Start with walking. It's free, and almost everyone can do it. Walk for twenty minutes three times a week, then build up.
W: Should people buy special shoes?
M: Good shoes matter, but you don't need the most expensive pair. Comfort is the key.
W: What mistake do beginners make?
M: They do too much in the first week. Then they feel sore and stop. Rest is part of training.
W: How do you stay motivated?
M: I train with a friend. We talk while we run, so it feels like meeting someone rather than exercising.
W: Any advice for someone who hates running?
M: Try swimming or cycling. The best exercise is the one you will keep doing.

questions.text: What does the coach suggest beginners do first?
What does the coach say about running shoes?
What mistake do beginners often make?

options.B: They exercise too much at first.

questions.text: How does the coach stay motivated?

materials.label: 第10段材料
materials.transcript: M: Good afternoon, students. Next week is Health Week at our school. On Monday, a doctor will talk about sleep and why teenagers need eight to ten hours a night. The talk begins at four in the library. On Wednesday, the cooking club will show you how to make a healthy lunch in twenty minutes. You can taste the food, but you must sign up at the school office by Tuesday. On Friday, there will be a fun run around the sports field. It starts at three and lasts about forty minutes. You don't need to be fast; walking is fine too. Remember to bring a water bottle. Parents are welcome to watch. All events are free, and they will be fun. I hope you will join us and learn something useful.

questions.text: What is the Monday talk about?
What must students do to join the cooking activity?
How does the speaker sound when inviting students?
